ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Contract renewals, Awaiting signature and later stages need Amount and Close date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Contract_renewals", CASE(StageName, "Upcoming", 1, "Review meeting", 2, "Terms proposed", 3, "Awaiting signature", 4, "Renewed", 5, 0) >= 4, OR(ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(CloseDate)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Amount and Close date before moving to Awaiting signature.
